I have created a couple of PRs to the spec. 
1. Just a fix for inconsistent wording (no-op for implementation in most cases) https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12212
2. A slight behavior change for charging frame target access on first touch (needs implementation update) https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12211
